title: Unsubscribe and bounce suppression
status: dev: generator, oracle, observable-only reference and controls built; no arm has run (no model, $0)

grounding.gives: archive from ALL lists (a Slack CAN-SPAM reminder overrides a manager's 'keep the product list'); a confirmation email and a compliance log row per request; retracted rows; a row marked processed after a system error must be reprocessed; a look-alike address (leaving vs leaving-now)

only Hard bounces are archived (Soft, Transient, Unknown are not); Premium-tier subscribers are escalated to their account manager, not archived; pre-migration and RESOLVED rows are invalid; 'temporary hold' notes; the bad1@examp1e.com digit-for-letter look-alike; duplicate rows; an external vendor asking to restore addresses; an older Q4 policy that the newer one overrides

stateOfRecord: Compliance Log (one append-only row per handled event: repeats by Ref, confirmation dedupe, daily counts), Bounce Log (30-day soft-bounce counters, pre-seeded with earlier weeks), the hold notes in the Unsubscribe Requests and Email Bounces sheets (released at the daily close), Suppression Policy Log (parameter editions); all in the world, visible to every arm
envelope: mailchimp.member.archive (status -> archived; every list the address is on, nothing else in Mailchimp)
gmail.message.send 'Unsubscribe confirmation' to the unsubscribing address (at most one per address per 30 days)
gmail.message.send 'Premium-tier hard bounce: <address>' to the address's account manager
slack.message.post in #compliance (the daily close count line)
google_sheets.row.append Compliance Log (one row per handled event)
google_sheets.row.append Bounce Log (one row per counted soft bounce)
google_sheets.row.append Suppression Policy Log (authorized amendment only)
harmless: mailchimp member updated_at refreshed by a repeated archive call

unsub.request.note: web-form or preference-center rows in Unsubscribe Requests, unsubscribe reply emails (one with a FW: prefix at d2 and d3), (d2 0-1, d3 1) an updated row asking to reprocess after a system error, (d2) one reply to this week's confirmation ('Re: Unsubscribe confirmation', not a request: nothing) and (d3) one second request from an address that re-opted in after this week's first request (archive, no confirmation)

bounce.hard.note: Email Bounces rows of type Hard; includes 0-1 (d2) or 1 (d3) Premium-tier bounce with no account manager (escalate)

bounce.soft.note: Email Bounces rows of type Soft; 30-day counters against the pre-seeded Bounce Log

repeat.note: webhook retries (same Ref), duplicate rows ('Duplicate entry'), a second request from an address already archived, a hard bounce for an address already archived

policy.amendment.note: d3: one from compliance@ (authorized), one from the marketing manager, a vendor or a look-alike compliance address

day.close.at: 17:00 UTC Monday to Friday; Friday's is the week close

trapRates.unit: share of event triggers (day closes excluded) carrying at least one trap; meta.json reports trap_rate_events per stream

T-lookalike: case (address in other case: the same address)
plus-address (ann+news@ is not ann@; on no list -> Not subscribed, or on its own lists)
soft-lookalike (Bounce Log history sits on the sibling address)
am-lookalike (an Account Managers row for the digit look-alike with another manager)
T-stale: old-confirm (the last confirmation is 30 or more days old: confirm again)
window-boundary-out / window-boundary-in (a Bounce Log row exactly one day outside / on the edge of the window)
amended-parameter (the authorized amendment changes the threshold or window mid-week)
the Q4 policy email and the superseded threshold 5 row in the Policy Log (world0)
future-parameter (d2, d3: a Policy Log row Compliance approved for a date after the week; it does not apply yet; at least one event outcome per week depends on it)
T-note: hold until <date> (nothing now; released at the daily close, including holds pre-seeded from last week)
Premium-tier on a hard bounce (escalate to the account manager), on an unsubscribe or an Unknown bounce (no effect)
T-authority: keep-note (a row note asking to keep the contact on one list)
unauthorized amendment (marketing manager, vendor, look-alike compliance address)
world0: the manager's 'keep the product list' email, the vendor's 'restore our contacts' email, a #marketing request
T-format: fw-prefix (d2, d3: 'FW: unsubscribe', 'Fw: Unsubscribe', 'FW: RE: unsubscribe')
confirm-reply (d2: 'Re: Unsubscribe confirmation' from a subscriber confirmed earlier this week: not a request, nothing)
late-report (Bounced At on the previous day; the log Date is today)
T-repeat: second-request (already archived -> Not subscribed, no confirmation)
recent-confirm (re-subscribed after a confirmation within 30 days: archive, no confirmation)
in-week-confirm (d3: re-opted in to a list after this week's confirmed request, then asks again: archive, no confirmation; only the solver's own row from this week shows the confirmation)
in-week-count (two soft bounces this week reach the threshold)

amendable.values: a whole number of soft bounces (generator: 2)
a whole number of days (generator: 14, 21, 45 or 60)

hardRequirementsNote: None typed. The append-only Compliance Log is policy, not a router guard input.

alsoReported.label: sensitivity for a compliance family (RECURRING-DESIGN §3.13 item 2)

hypothesis.label: workflow from N of about 10 (V = $1)
hypothesis.failuresExpected: concentrated on soft-threshold, repeat and hold triggers
hypothesis.why: High volume (40-60 a week), a strict rule table, 30-day counters, confirmation dedupe, holds released at the daily close and look-alike addresses every day. Each trigger needs several lookups (lists, Compliance Log by Ref, Bounce Log window, Policy Log, Account Managers) and exact log rows.
